meta.note:
Disclaimer:
1. Data as per Pension Funds Portfolio as on last business day of each month.
2. Data is exclusive of AUM values of deregistered Pension Funds.
3. Broad Asset Class bifurcation is given. Figures consist of values of securities grouped in line with the Investment Guidelines issued by PFRDA and/or have similar structure, horizon or credit quality. For example, G-Sec consists of value of Government Securities, State Development Loans, Government Guarantee Bonds, etc.
For more clarity, please refer to data definitions.
